retention.law: EPHEMERAL BY DEFAULT. Raw sense material is released at the next step. Only a bounded typed receipt survives.
retention.released_when: before the typed observation is returned
retention.accumulation_across_uses: flat and zero after every release boundary
retention.deletion_scope: only material created by the exact sense use, by exact id or path; never a wildcard or recursive sweep

skills.oneLine: Wrap a host-supplied static-image observation without claiming capture or motion proof.
procedure: Require an attributable host-supplied static observation.
Compare typed visible and absent facts with the bounded claim.
Return UNKNOWN for motion, timing, or live-state claims.
Seal a digest and retain no image bytes.
boundaries: Does not capture an image.
Does not infer motion from one image.
Does not inherit host authority.

skills.oneLine: Observe a bounded live visual window, seal a digest, and release every raw frame.
procedure: Name one claim and target.
Open a bounded rolling buffer through an injected capture adapter.
Observe a time-ordered sequence.
Seal a typed digest.
Release all frames before return.
boundaries: No automatic capture.
No click or write authority.
No raw video archive.

skills.oneLine: Compare two attributable typed observations of the same target at different times and report exactly what changed without inferring why.
procedure: Require two attributable typed observations of the same target with ordered timestamps.
Require the same fact identifiers at both times, using present=false for known absence.
Classify each fact as SAME, CHANGED, APPEARED, or DISAPPEARED.
Treat an optional structural-hash delta as corroborating evidence only.
Judge only the named expected or refuting change and seal value digests without raw values.
boundaries: Does not capture or interpret an image.
Does not infer the cause of a change.
Does not compare different targets or incomplete fact dimensions.
Does not treat one observation as a change.
Does not retain supplied fact values or inherit host authority.

skills.oneLine: Measure bounded live or supplied presentation properties against the AXM accessibility floor and flag violations without restyling or claiming a full audit.
procedure: Read bounded supplied measurements or request them from an injected exact-target computed-style adapter.
Reuse Visual Kernel contrast math and apply the declared floor: 4.5:1 normal text, 3:1 large text and UI components, 44px targets, critical text at least 10px, and a visible equal for sound signals.
Attach the measured number to every PASS, FAIL, or UNKNOWN rule result.
Return UNKNOWN for missing or invalid property groups; partial input is never a silent PASS.
Seal typed measurements, release the supplied set, and take no direct action.
boundaries: Does not restyle, repair, or auto-adjust a surface.
Does not read text content, content meaning, or judge taste.
Does not claim WCAG certification or a full accessibility audit.
Does not retain raw pixels or the supplied property set.
A missing per-use adapter, incomplete element coverage, gradients, background images, transparency, or ancestor opacity remain explicit UNKNOWN results.

skills.oneLine: Read one bounded event window, treat silence as data, and release the stream buffer.
procedure: Open one named bounded stream window.
Prefer refuting evidence.
Record silence and eviction.
Seal matched typed events and digest.
Release the buffer.
boundaries: Does not alter the source log.
Does not keep a transcript.
Does not listen beyond the declared window.

skills.oneLine: Stamp evidence age and refuse malformed, future, untimed, or stale facts as current.
procedure: Validate the observation timestamp.
Assign bounded TTL by volatility.
Calculate age at intended use.
Return LIVE, STALE, UNTIMED, INVALID_TIMESTAMP, or FUTURE.
Inherit the shortest TTL.
boundaries: Freshness is not truth.
Does not re-observe.
Does not authorize action.

skills.oneLine: Probe only named OS, path, separator, and tool assumptions without installing or repairing.
procedure: Read declared assumptions.
Probe only exact named items.
Diff assumed and actual.
Return mismatches or unknown holds.
Release probe material.
boundaries: No home-directory enumeration.
No install or repair.
No wildcard path.

skills.oneLine: Carry typed facts, holds, and next steps across processes while re-reading access.
procedure: Write one typed record at turn end.
Separate verified and assumed facts.
Append exact holds and next step.
Read in a fresh process.
Re-read access instead of inheriting it.
boundaries: Continuity is not authority.
No prior record rewrite.
No raw sensory payload.

skills.oneLine: Archive verified cold provenance with hash and retrieval proof, leaving a hot digest.
procedure: Preview exact hot and archive paths.
Read the owned source.
Write and read back archive.
Compare digest before hot replacement.
Leave a retrievable hot digest.
boundaries: No deletion of provenance.
No uncertain ownership.
No raw sensory buffers.

skills.oneLine: Compare bounded typed receipt features only with the same seat's reviewed baseline.
procedure: Form a bounded same-seat feature baseline.
Require reviewed baseline identity.
Compare declared axes.
Route possible drift for review.
Take no direct action.
boundaries: No cross-identity comparison.
No punishment or routing change.
No hidden transcript or reasoning capture.

skills.oneLine: Compare sealed same-claim receipts from distinct seats without voting, ranking seats, or choosing a winner.
procedure: Validate bounded sealed receipt envelopes for one claim.
Count each distinct seat once and refuse ambiguous same-seat observations.
Require one capability family and version.
Compare verdict, typed-observation digest, and named seams.
Return CONVERGENT, DIVERGENT, INSUFFICIENT, or INCOMPARABLE and take no action.
boundaries: No raw frames, transcripts, readings, or payloads.
No voting, averaging, seat ranking, or tiebreaking.
Agreement is evidence, not canon or authority.
Divergence routes to a human or independent gate.

skills.oneLine: Classify a seat's own host-supplied capacity headroom and recommend timely compaction or handoff without acting.
procedure: Request bounded fill-level signals for the invoking seat from an injected host adapter.
Refuse cross-seat, missing, invalid, or over-budget readings as UNKNOWN.
Compute the minimum declared headroom and classify AMPLE, TIGHTENING, or NEAR_LIMIT.
Recommend continue, compact soon, or seal handoff now.
Seal the reading and take no direct action.
boundaries: No context content inspection or summarization.
No estimation of another seat's capacity.
No hardware-body substitution for cognitive capacity.
No automatic compaction, truncation, or handoff.
Missing host metrics remain an explicit UNKNOWN hold.

skills.oneLine: Inspect one bounded incoming handoff for concrete integrity and injection-shaped warning signals without declaring guilt or taking action.
procedure: Require one exact material identity and one caller-supplied bounded string or byte array.
Compute SHA-256 and compare an optional expected digest.
For declared text, inspect deterministic encoding, control-character, binary-signature, injection-shaped, credential-shaped, and declared-JSON signals.
Return NO_TAINT_SIGNAL, TAINT_SIGNALLED, or UNKNOWN with named signals and no raw excerpt.
Route warnings to review, release the sample, and take no direct action.
boundaries: No path or URL fetching and no material execution.
No malware verdict, reputation lookup, signer validation, or semantic intent judgment.
No automatic trust, block, quarantine, deletion, promotion, or permission change.
A warning is not proof of guilt; no warning is not proof of safety.
Raw material and matched excerpts never enter the retained receipt.
